name: a PASS with no evidence
why: PASS must rest on something that ran (P4: no success without evidence)

name: a PASS whose evidence all exited non-zero
why: a failed export cannot back a PASS

name: a PASS resting only on a file
why: a sync verdict needs the comparison that produced it

name: a PASS without the connection it checked
why: a PASS for an unnamed Builder says nothing about the one being imported into

name: a check PASS that wrote no marker
why: check PASS <=> marker written: the hook and the result must agree

name: a written marker without its expiry
why: a consumer must be able to tell when the authorization lapses

name: a CONFLICT that left a marker
why: only a PASS authorizes

name: a CONFLICT from check-export
why: CONFLICT is the Builder holding work an import would destroy

name: a CONFLICT over line endings only
why: line-ending differences never gate

name: a FAIL from check-import
why: check-import diverging is CONFLICT, not FAIL

name: NOT_RUN emitted by a producer
why: NOT_RUN is assigned only by a consumer

name: a PASS carrying another status's reason
why: the reason catalog binds each code to one status

name: a result with no reason
why: every verdict names its reason

name: a recorded syncpoint without its basis
why: record-sync must say what proved the Builder held no unsynchronized work

name: a recorded syncpoint without its commit
why: recorded means a commit exists

name: a basis on a check
why: basis belongs to record-sync

name: a marker on record-sync
why: record-sync authorizes nothing

name: a payload on check-export
why: the payload is what an import deploys

name: an APEX session id in a message (session=)
why: a session id is a credential (P10)

name: an APEX session id in a message (f?p=)
why: a session id is a credential (P10)

name: a connect string in evidence
why: user/password@host never lands in evidence (P10)

name: a password assignment in a message
why: secrets never land in evidence (P10)

name: a connect string as the connection name
why: a saved-connection NAME only

name: an absolute path in changes
why: paths are repo-relative: an absolute one names the user and the machine

name: a drive-letter path in changes
why: paths are repo-relative

name: a '..' segment in a path
why: a result never points outside the repository

name: a task id that leaves the evidence dir
why: the task id names a directory under the evidence dir

name: an unknown property
why: additionalProperties: false — a field nobody specified is nobody's contract

name: a schemaVersion this schema is not
why: schemaVersion 1 only
